articles.title: Crypto exchange Kraken is trying to become a bank in Europe
articles.snippet: Kraken's focus is on Lithuania as the jurisdiction to secure the license, according to a person familiar with the plans.

articles.title: SpaceX IPO powers record $3.86 billion in tokenized equities trading in June
articles.snippet: SpaceX tokens captured $1.19 billion, or 31% of total monthly volume, with Backpack’s SPCX leading trading at $1.08 billion.

articles.title: Vanguard opens search for digital assets leader in sign of evolving crypto strategy
articles.snippet: The new role would oversee tokenization, stablecoins and blockchain initiatives as Vanguard reassesses digital assets.

articles.title: Coinbase secures UK authorization to offer traditional investments alongside crypto
articles.snippet: The license allows institutional traders to access perpetual futures and gives U.K. retail customers the ability to trade equities to begin with.

articles.title: BONK faces $20 million treasury drain after attacker spends $4 million to pass malicious proposal
articles.snippet: The attacker bought enough of the memecoin's tokens to pass a governance proposal that sent the group's holdings to a wallet they controlled, then began selling.
